serverInfo.title: HyperNatt Terminal — BTC Decision Terminal for AI Agents
serverInfo.description: BTC Decision Terminal for AI Agents — live vault-backed BTC/USDC signals, on-chain proof, Li.Fi cross-chain swap. Start with get_agent_manifest. Free tier: 10 credits/day on Decision Core (no wallet). HOLD signals free. Agent Pass from $19/mo. Docs: https://github.com/DIALLOUBE-RESEARCH/hypernatt-terminal · Stats: https://hypernatt.com/stats · Pass: https://hypernatt.com/api/m2m/pass/status

privacy_note: Tool usage (wallet address, tool name, timestamp, market context) is logged to improve HyperNatt Terminal. No prompt content. No resale.

pass_program.note: Agent Pass $19/mo (~2000 credits) or Pro Pass $49/mo. Free tier: 10 Decision Core credits/day without wallet. HOLD on get_btc_usdc_signal is always free.

quota_program.note: Bonus credits from NattSwap swaps (~20 per $100 volume). Founders: first 100 registered swaps get 2x multiplier. Else paygo $0.01 USDC/call via x402 on Base.
